summary.result: For drainage water, the concentrations of T-N and COD slightly decrease with discharge, while the T-P concentrations slightly increase with discharge.
summary.background: The most common order in average concentrations of T-P and COD is podded water > irrigation(or drainage) water > percolated water.
summary.method: Most of pollutants concentrations in drainage water are lower than those in irrigation water after early July due to large uptake of pollutants by rice crop and denitrification.
